rows._notes: 'role' is empty on every Autumn row because roles are assigned by rule when the map loads (see map_roles). These names are the default layout, written for the guessed layout below (Lumière and the Monolith in opposite corners, the Axons beside the Monolith, Old Lumière a central ruin). When a role lands on another clearing, that clearing and the one named after the role here swap names for that game. engineClearingId, suit, corner and ruin are guesses on every row, with 4 fox, 4 rabbit and 4 mouse clearings, 4 corners and 4 ruins.
